response.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist

assumptions.assumption: The count is the number of matched (advancedbehavior, transactionrecord) pairs per order type mix. Since translink is a foreign key to the transactionrecord primary key, each advanced behaviour record matches at most one transaction record, so this equals the number of advanced behaviour records.
Records with NULL patsim are excluded by the >= 0.439 filter, and NULL ordertypedist forms its own group, which GROUP BY does naturally.
